Opposite Party/s
 ======================================================
 Appearance :
 For the Petitioner/s : Mr. S.D. Sanjay, Advocate
 Mr. Shashi Kant Singh, Advocate
 For the Opposite Party/s : Mr.Anand Mohan Prasad Mehta, App
 For the Informant : Mr. Kedar Jha, Advocate
 ======================================================
 Coram: Honourable Mr. Justice Sandeep Kumar
 Oral Order

. This application has been filed for quashing the order dated 07.09.2019 passed by the learned S.D.J.M. Darbhanga in Mahila P.S. Case No. 60 of 2017 by which cognizance has been taken against the petitioners for the offences under Sections 498A/34, 376/34, 377/34, 354/34 of the I.P.C. and Section 3 and 4 of the D.P. Act.
2.
Heard the learned senior counsel for the petitioners and learned counsel for the O.P. NO. 2 and learned APP for the State.

3. As per the prosecution case, on 14 th of July, Patna High Court CR. MISC. No.85856 of 2019(8)
dt.19-07-2023 2014, the complainant was married to co-accused Manjeet Ranjan.

entities.text: 14 th of July, Patna High Court
entities.label: DATE

sentences.text:
In the time of marriage, gifts worth Rs. 30,00,000/- including cash Rs. 15,00,000/- was given to the husband of Kailash Kharga @ Kailash Kumar Kharga vs The State Of Bihar on 19 July, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/3105219/
1

entities.text: Kailash Kharga @ Kailash Kumar Kharga vs The State Of Bihar
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text:
Her husband used to do un-natural sex and after giving intoxicant two unknown boys raped upon her.
4.

learned counsel for the petitioners submits that the petitioners are the maternal father-in-law and cousin father- in-law (Mausera father-in-law) of the informant and petitioners have been implicated in this case because they are the relatives of the husband namely Manjeet Ranjan.
5. Affidavit has been filed by the S.H.O. Mahila Police Station, Darbhanga.
In her affidavit, she has said that there is general and omnibus allegation against the petitioners and there is no specific allegation against the petitioners.
6. Learned counsel for the opposite party no. 2 has submitted that the allegations levelled against the petitioners are true and because of this, their prosecution cannot be quashed.
7. I have considered the submissions of the parties.

8. In view of the general and omnibus allegation against the petitioners and in view of the judgment of Hon'ble Supreme Court in the case of Kahkashan Kausar @ Sonam vs State of Bihar 2022 SCC OnLine SC 162, this application is Patna High Court CR. MISC. No.85856 of 2019(8) dt.19-07-2023 allowed.

entities.text: Kahkashan Kausar @ Sonam vs State of Bihar 2022 SCC OnLine SC 162
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: 9. The entire prosecution of the petitioners and the order dated 07.09.2019 passed by the learned S.D.J.M. Darbhanga in Mahila P.S. Case No. 60 of 2017 are hereby quashed.

(Sandeep Kumar, J) Shishir/-
